title: Jiwa nyang jaga bak binèh kruëng .
intro: Saboh jiwa muda geubri amanah deungon misi rahasia, untuk geukaloen dari jarak yang aman watee takdir teungoh berlangsong di ateuh ie. Hana deuh dan hana diduga, tokoh nyoe akan meumeuen peran penteng lam meuubah jalan seujarah saboh nanggroe.
clues: Lon dijok saboh tugaih le mak, saboh tugaih nyang peureulee siluman dan waspada.
Mata lon meuikot saboh buai ubeut nyang meulayang-layang di seupanyang arus, hate lon brat ngon khawatir.
Watèë djiteumeung lé pihak njang hana teudjadi, ulôn peurab, peunoh deungon teumakôt.
Lon kalon keputusasaan awak nyan keu sidroe penjaga dan lon tawarkan solusi tanpa lon peugah keubeunaran.
Intervensi lon bak watee nyang tepat jiba jiwa nyang menyusui kembali keu ureung nyang paleng peureulee.

Di peungadilan-peungadilan ureuëng-ureuëng nyang meukuasa, ulôn peugah haba: 'Peu kheueh ulôn harôh lôn arahkan gata ubak saboh keuluwarga nyang teuma jipeulara gobnyan dan jijaga gobnyan deungon jroh-jroh?'

trial.label: Sidang/Acara
options: Peu rhom aneuk miet lam krueng .
trial.answer: Peu rhom aneuk miet lam krueng .

outcome.label: Hasee
options: Gobnyan geupeusaboh lom aneuk nyan ngon mak jih .
Gobnyan geupeuseulamat droe geuh nibak sipa-i Firaun .
outcome.answer: Gobnyan geupeusaboh lom aneuk nyan ngon mak jih .

arabic: ۞ وَحَرَّمْنَا عَلَيْهِ ٱلْمَرَاضِعَ مِن قَبْلُ فَقَالَتْ هَلْ أَدُلُّكُمْ عَلَىٰٓ أَهْلِ بَيْتٍۢ يَكْفُلُونَهُۥ لَكُمْ وَهُمْ لَهُۥ نَـٰصِحُونَ
verse: And We had prevented from him [all] wet nurses before, so she said, "Shall I direct you to a household that will be responsible for him for you while they are to him [for his upbringing] sincere?" (28:12)
